Nadia Khoury is a sharp, driven machine learning engineer who consistently delivers high-impact solutions in cybersecurity threat detection.  

Nadia designed Kafka-based ingestion pipelines that scaled to 10M+ events/day, reducing false positives by 22% through custom anomaly detection logic. She built Spark-based ETL workflows that integrated with Snowflake, enabling real-time threat scoring for 500+ enterprise clients. Her dbt models transformed raw logs into actionable insights, streamlining incident response by 30%.  

Nadia’s NLP work on threat intelligence parsing—using Hugging Face Transformers and PyTorch—cut malware classification latency by 40%. She owns Airflow pipelines that automate model retraining, ensuring detection models stay ahead of evolving threats. Her MLOps expertise, including TensorFlow model deployment and scikit-learn-based baselines, ensures systems are robust, scalable, and maintainable.  

Nadia’s curiosity and rigor are unmatched. She’ll ask “why” until systems are optimized, and she’ll take ownership of problems others avoid. A pleasure to work with.
